6064-memoirs-of-lady-fanshawe-wife-of-si.creator: Unknown
6064-memoirs-of-lady-fanshawe-wife-of-si.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. t was written by his widow in the evening of her days, after a life of storm and stress and many romantic adventures at home and abroad, for the benefit of the only son who survived to manhood of fourteen children, most of whom died in their chrisom robes and whose baby bones were laid to rest in foreign churchyards.

arxiv-2107-02373.title: Measurement of the branching fraction for B 0 → π 0 ​ π 0 B^{0}\rightarrow\pi^{0}\pi^{0} decays reconstructed in 2019–2020 Belle II data
arxiv-2107-02373.creator: F. Abudinén, I. Adachi, R. Adak, K. Adamczyk, P. Ahlburg, J. K. Ahn, H. Aihara, N. Akopov, A. Aloisio, F. Ameli, L. Andricek, N. Anh Ky, D. M. Asner, H. Atmacan, V. Aulchenko, T. Aushev, V. Aushev, T. Aziz, V. Babu, S. Bacher, S. Baehr, S. Bahinipati, A. M. Bakich, P. Bambade, Sw. Banerjee, S. Bansa
arxiv-2107-02373.description: Abstract We report the first reconstruction of the B 0 → π 0 ​ π 0 B^{0}\rightarrow\pi^{0}\pi^{0} decay mode at Belle II using samples of 2019 and 2020 data that correspond to 62.8 fb − 1 \mbox{\,fb}^{-1} of integrated luminosity. We find 14.0 − 5.6 + 6.8 14.0^{+6.8}_{-5.6} signal decays, corresponding to a significance of 3.

arxiv-2107-08047.title: Quantum computations (course of lectures)
arxiv-2107-08047.creator: Yuri I. Ozhigov
arxiv-2107-08047.description: Abstract Key words: Quantum computer, quantum algorithm, decoherence, quantum modeling, quantum non locality Annotation This course of lectures has been taught for several years at the Lomonosov Moscow State University; its modified version in 2021 is read in the Zhejiang University (Hangzhou), in the framework of summer school on quantum computing.

arxiv-2109-07879.title: Accurate and robust splitting methods for the generalized Langevin equation with a positive Prony series memory kernel
arxiv-2109-07879.creator: Manh Hong Duong, Xiaocheng Shang
arxiv-2109-07879.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Manh Hong Duong, Xiaocheng Shang. We study numerical methods for the generalized Langevin equation (GLE) with a positive Prony series memory kernel, in which case the GLE can be written in an extended variable Markovian formalism. We propose a new splitting method that is easy to implement and is able to substantially improve the accuracy and robustness of GLE simulations in a wide range of the parameters.

arxiv-2110-15391.title: Phenomenological analysis of multi-pseudoscalar mediated dark matter models
arxiv-2110-15391.creator: Shankha Banerjee, ​​, Geneviève Bélanger, ​​, Disha Bhatia, ​​, Benjamin Fuks, ​ and Sreerup Raychaudhuri
arxiv-2110-15391.description: Abstract Non-minimal simplified extensions of the Standard Model have gained considerable currency in the context of dark matter searches at the LHC, since they predict enhanced mono-Higgs and mono- W / Z W/Z signatures over large parts of the parameter space.

arxiv-2204-02830.title: Free-Space Quantum Key Distribution with Single Photons from Defects in Hexagonal Boron Nitride
arxiv-2204-02830.creator: Çağlar Samaner, Serkan Paçal, Görkem Mutlu, Kıvanç Uyanık, Serkan Ateş
arxiv-2204-02830.description: Abstract We present a proof-of-concept demonstration of free space quantum key distribution (QKD) with single photons generated from an isolated defect in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN). The source, operating at room temperature with a 10% brightness, is integrated into a B92 protocol and a secure key rate (SKR) of 238 bps and a quantum bit error rate (QBER) of 8.

arxiv-2207-12083.title: A Milestone for FaaS Pipelines, Object Storage- vs VM-Driven Data Exchange
arxiv-2207-12083.creator: Germán T. Eizaguirre, Marc Sánchez-Artigas, Pedro García-López
arxiv-2207-12083.description: Abstract . Serverless functions provide high levels of parallelism, short start-up times, and “pay-as-you-go” billing. These attributes make them a natural substrate for data analytics workflows. However, the impossibility of direct communication between functions makes the execution of workflows challenging. The current practice to share intermediate data among functions is through remote object storage (e.g., IBM COS).

arxiv-2209-06888.title: ADAMANT: A Pipeline for Adaptable Manipulation Tasks
arxiv-2209-06888.creator: Ana Huamán QuispeStephen HartSeth Gee, Robert R. Burridge
arxiv-2209-06888.description: Abstract This paper presents ADAMANT, a set of software modules that provides grasp planning capabilities to an existing robot planning and control software framework. Our presented work allows a user to adapt a manipulation task to be used under widely different scenarios with minimal user input, thus reducing the operator’s cognitive load.

arxiv-2310-07800.title: Language-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Hard Attention in Few-Shot Learning
arxiv-2310-07800.creator: Bahareh Nikpour, Narges Armanfard
arxiv-2310-07800.description: Abstract Attention mechanisms have demonstrated significant potential in enhancing learning models by identifying key portions of input data, particularly in scenarios with limited training samples. Inspired by human perception, we propose that focusing on essential data segments, rather than the entire dataset, can improve the accuracy and reliability of the learning models.

arxiv-2406-09358.title: Understanding Hallucinations in Diffusion Models through Mode Interpolation
arxiv-2406-09358.creator: Sumukh K Aithal, Pratyush Maini, Zachary C. Lipton, J. Zico Kolter, Carnegie Mellon University, DatologyAI {saithal, pratyus2, zlipton, zkolter}@cs.cmu.edu
arxiv-2406-09358.description: Abstract Colloquially speaking, image generation models based upon diffusion processes are frequently said to exhibit “hallucinations”—samples that could never occur in the training data. But where do such hallucinations come from? In this paper, we study a particular failure mode in diffusion models, which we term mode interpolation.

arxiv-2506-04842.title: MineInsight: A Multi-sensor Dataset for Humanitarian Demining Robotics in Off-Road Environments
arxiv-2506-04842.creator: Mario Malizia, Charles Hamesse, Ken Hasselmann
arxiv-2506-04842.description: Abstract The use of robotics in humanitarian demining increasingly involves computer vision techniques to improve landmine detection capabilities. However, in the absence of diverse and realistic datasets, the reliable validation of algorithms remains a challenge for the research community. In this paper, we introduce MineInsight, a publicly available multi-sensor, multi-spectral dataset designed for off-road landmine detection.

arxiv-2509-10840.title: Hermitian vs non-Hermitian quantum thermometry
arxiv-2509-10840.creator: Anass Hminat, Abdallah Slaoui, Rachid Ahl Laamara, Mourad Telmini
arxiv-2509-10840.description: Abstract We investigate the dephasing dynamics of a qubit as an effective mechanism for estimating the temperature of its surrounding environment for different symmetrizes. Our approach is fundamentally quantum, leveraging the qubit’s susceptibility to decoherence without necessitating thermal equilibrium with the system under study.

arxiv-2602-15151.title: Revisiting transportation problems under Monge costs with applications to location problems
arxiv-2602-15151.creator: Stefan Nickel, Justo Puerto, Simon Ramoser, Alberto Torrejon
arxiv-2602-15151.description: Abstract We investigate the transportation problem under a Monge cost structure and derive compact formulas for optimal dual solutions based on the northwest-corner rule. As an application illustrating how these formulas yield structural insight while enhancing computational performance, we consider a broad class of facility location problems.

arxiv-2606-14134.title: Source Surface Height Optimisation for Improved Solar Wind Velocity Forecasting Across Solar Cycles 23, 24 and 25.

doe-osti-3797065-final-technical-report-.creator: Schwarz, Philip Alexander
doe-osti-3797065-final-technical-report-.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. The final technical report, demonstrating that reusable packaging systems represent a viable pathway to reduce waste, lower logistics costs, and improve operational efficiency in large-scale solar projects.

pmc-10537512.title: Heterotic grouping of provitamin A-enriched maize inbred lines for increased provitamin A content in hybrids
pmc-10537512.creator: Abdoul-Raouf Sayadi Maazou, Melaku Gedil, Victor O. Adetimirin, Nnanna Unachukwu, Wende Mengesha, Silvestro Meseka, Abebe Menkir
pmc-10537512.description: BackgroundThe establishment of heterotic groups of inbred lines is crucial for hybrid maize breeding programs. Currently, there is no information on the heterotic patterns of the Provitamin A (PVA) inbred lines developed in the maize improvement program of the International Institute of Tropical Agriculture (IITA) to form productive PVA enriched hybrids for areas affected by vitamin A deficiency.

pmc-10736197.title: Is Lymphedema Cure a Clinical Reality?
pmc-10736197.creator: Wei F. Chen, Ying C. Ku, Takumi Yamamoto, Sonia K. Pandey
pmc-10736197.description: debate on these procedures' efficacies continues. More specifically, is lymphedema surgically curable? Here, we offer our experience and viewpoint. In our experience, with cure defined as a patient being free of all lymphedema-related symptoms without the need for further treatments including the use of compression garments, lymphedema cure is most definitely a clinical reality.

pmc-11317889.title: Long‐term rehabilitation with interferential current stimulation for persistent dysphagia in anti‐N‐methyl‐d‐aspartate receptor encephalitis: A case report
pmc-11317889.creator: Takahiro Sugahara, Shinsuke Nagami, Ryota Sato, Naohiko Ishizaki, Ichiro Fujishima, Fumihito Aikawa
pmc-11317889.description: Key Clinical MessageAnti‐N‐methyl‐d‐aspartate receptor encephalitis is an autoimmune disorder characterized by various neurological symptoms with a relatively favorable prognosis. We present a case of prolonged dysphagia successfully managed with outpatient rehabilitation, including interferential current stimulation and resistance exercises. Significant improvement was observed, highlighting the efficacy of combined treatment in overcoming chronic dysphagia.

pmc-11495666.title: Comparison of the CYP3A Selective Inhibitors CYP3cide, Clobetasol, and Azamulin for Their Potential to Distinguish CYP3A7 Activity in the Presence of CYP3A4/5
pmc-11495666.creator: Hannah M. Work, Sylvie E. Kandel, Jed N. Lampe
pmc-11495666.description: The CYP3A7 enzyme accounts for ∼50% of the total cytochrome P450 (P450) content in fetal and neonatal livers and is the predominant P450 involved in neonatal xenobiotic metabolism. Additionally, it is a key player in healthy birth outcomes through the oxidation of dehydroepiandrosterone (DHEA) and DHEA-sulfate.

pmc-11513384.title: What's emotion got to do with it? Reflections on the buildings of the Portuguese (Family) Courts
pmc-11513384.creator: Patrícia Branco
pmc-11513384.description: Courthouses, as public edifices, serve as the physical backdrop for the administration of justice. Simultaneously, they are spaces inhabited and visited by a diverse array of court users, ranging from judicial professionals to litigants. This article explores the nuanced interplay between courthouse spaces and the emotional experiences they generate.

pmc-11518110.title: Focus on food instead of nutrients improves consumers’ understanding of meals’ nutrition quality
pmc-11518110.creator: C Viegas, E Lamy, M Prada, A Rocha
pmc-11518110.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundNowadays, most of the information directed to consumers focuses on nutrients, ignoring the impact of the interactions between different foods, origin or degree of processing. The methodologies currently applied have led consumers to confuse foods with nutrients, meat and fish are often referred to as “proteins”, grains and potatoes are referred to as “carbohydrates, forgetting that these foods are source of other nutrients, such as fat, proteins or fibre.

pmc-11533658.title: Integrating Ayurvedic philosophy with modern technologies for drug research and development: A critical need of mechanistic insights for wider acceptability
pmc-11533658.creator: Chavan Sandeep, Vidya Gupta, Vineeta Deshmukh, Sadanand Sardeshmukh
pmc-11533658.description: Ayurveda is a holistic science emphasizing healing and maintaining harmony and balance in the body. Medicines from natural resources and in pre-defined dosage forms are integral parts of successful Ayurvedic treatment in various diseases including complex ailments, such as cancer. Ayurvedic medicines are cocktails of several active phyto-compounds and/or natural resources and no isolated/purified molecules are used in the treatment.

pmc-12403554.title: County-level residential segregation and sedentary behavior in US adults
pmc-12403554.creator: Mohammad Moniruzzaman, Yangyang Deng, Breanna Rogers, Sheikh Mohammed Shariful Islam, Kelly K Jones, Pedro F Saint-Maurice, Shreya Patel, David Berrigan, Charles E Matthews, Kosuke Tamura
pmc-12403554.description: BackgroundExcessive sedentary behavior (SB) is highly prevalent among adults in the United States (US). From a socio-ecological perspective, residential segregation may affect SB; however, this remains understudied. Thus, we aimed to examine associations between county-level segregation and sedentary time in a nationwide sample of US adults.

pmc-12472895.title: Flagellimonas algicida sp. Nov.: A Novel Broad-Spectrum Algicidal Bacterium Targeting Harmful Algal Bloom Species and Genomic Insights into Its Secondary Metabolites
pmc-12472895.creator: Ning Wang, Yiling Liang, Hui Zhou, Yutian Chi, Lizhu Chen, Qiliang Lai, Hong Xu, O Roger Anderson
pmc-12472895.description: A novel Gram-negative bacterium, designated strain SN16T, was isolated from a harmful algal bloom (HAB). Strain SN16T exhibited potent, broad-spectrum algicidal activity against the colony-forming alga Phaeocystis globosa and eight other HAB-causing species, highlighting its potential as a promising candidate for the biological control of HABs.

pmc-12534111.title: Novel progress in the application of the small molecule drug carnosine for the treatment of several diseases (Review)
pmc-12534111.creator: Chao Fang, Daihan Xie, Lixin Xie, Zhiyuan Niu, Chunxia Su, Yu Huo
pmc-12534111.description: Carnosine is a dipeptide composed of β-alanine and L-histidine, linked by peptide bonds, and is widely distributed in muscle tissue, the central nervous system (including the brain) and various other organs. As an endogenous bioactive molecule, carnosine plays a crucial role in cellular metabolism and physiological regulation.

pmc-12535163.title: Triple burden of malnutrition in children and mothers from Ceará, brazil: a cross sectional study
pmc-12535163.creator: Sabrina G.M.O. Rocha, Luciano L. Correia, Márcia M.T. Machado, Álvaro J.M. Leite, Anamaria C. e Silva, Jocileide S. Campos, Sâmia G.M.O. Giacomini, Christopher R. Sudfeld, Hermano A.L. Rocha
pmc-12535163.description: This cross-sectional study evaluated the prevalence and associated factors of the triple burden of malnutrition (TBM)—defined as the coexistence of child undernutrition (low growth indices), anemia in children, and maternal overweight/obesity—in 3,200 mother-child pairs in Ceará, Brazil, in 2023. Standardized anthropometric measurements and hemoglobin levels were obtained. The prevalence of TBM was 3.9% (95% CI: 3.2–4.6), with 14.

pmc-12644478.title: Effect of metformin on insulin resistance in adults with type 1 diabetes: a 26-week randomized double-blind clinical trial
pmc-12644478.creator: Jennifer R. Snaith, Nick Olsen, Jennifer Evans, Greg M. Kowalski, Clinton R. Bruce, Dorit Samocha-Bonet, Samuel N. Breit, Deborah J. Holmes-Walker, Jerry R. Greenfield
pmc-12644478.description: Insulin resistance is an underrecognized cardiovascular risk factor in type 1 diabetes. The effect of metformin on insulin resistance in adults with type 1 diabetes is unknown. Forty adults with type 1 diabetes, and twenty adults without diabetes were studied in a baseline only cross-sectional study assessing insulin resistance using the two-step hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic clamp.

pmc-12903232.title: Orthologous genes of the red flour beetle Tribolium castaneum and the vinegar fly Drosophila melanogaster
pmc-12903232.creator: Noel Cabañas, Doga Cedden, Gregor Bucher
pmc-12903232.description: ObjectivesTribolium castaneum and Drosophila melanogaster are prominent insect model organisms for investigating developmental and evolutionary processes. Both have a significant kit of genetic and molecular tools and a substantial quantity of omic data at their disposal, which makes this species pair suitable for comparative genomic and gene function studies.

pmc-13049856.title: Characterization of JIA subtypes, clinical features, treatment patterns, and early outcomes in Palestinian children: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13049856.creator: Fawzy M Abunejma, Wasef Alhroub, Ahmad Fasfoos, Hala Imwas, Mina Hassan, Mohammad Ghawadreh
pmc-13049856.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundJuvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA) is the most common chronic rheumatologic disease of childhood and includes a heterogeneous group of subtypes with varying clinical presentations, laboratory profiles, and outcomes. Data from the Middle East, including Palestine, remain limited.

pmc-13051592.title: Change of guards: ELAVL proteins switch miRNA export responsibility to regulate differentiation of PC12 cells
pmc-13051592.creator: Sritama Ray, Suvendra N Bhattacharyya, Kamalika Mukherjee
pmc-13051592.description: In the rat pheochromocytoma cell line PC12, which resembles sympathetic neurons, miRNA activity decreases during differentiation, and inactivation of the let-7a miRNP is essential for differentiation. We sought to examine how let-7a activity is affected during differentiation. Extracellular vesicle-mediated miRNA export is a common strategy used by mammalian cells to regulate miRNA activity.

pmc-13219271.title: Mathematical cognitive structures in Grade 12 students: a mixed-methods concept map study of gender differences and computational ability
pmc-13219271.creator: Zhenping Wang, Junxiong Chen, Jin Liu, Qiaoyu Wu
pmc-13219271.description: This study employs a mixed-methods research design, primarily relying on quantitative analysis while incorporating qualitative analysis as a complementary approach. A total of 368 concept maps constructed by Grade 12 students were evaluated using the total proposition scoring method, the Novak’s structural scoring method, and the new structural scoring method.

pmc-13246204.title: Assessment of Artificial Intelligence-based Translation Tools for Emergency Department Discharge Instructions
pmc-13246204.creator: Estee Wu, Cassandra Mackey, Simi Jandu, Jennifer L Carey
pmc-13246204.description: IntroductionEmergency departments (ED) in the United States serve as a safety net for millions, including those with limited English proficiency (LEP). Eight percent of individuals living in the United States have LEP, placing them at risk for language barriers that can adversely affect the quality and safety of their care.

pmc-13575315.creator: Ayokunle John Tadema, Faith Mmesoma Nwosu, Oluwatumilara Ayokunle Abimbola
pmc-13575315.description: ObjectivesWe examined national temporal trends, laboratory-confirmation performance, and climate associations in Lassa fever surveillance in Nigeria from 2020 to 2025, and assessed the impact of the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic on surveillance metrics.MethodsWe analyzed 307 consecutive weeks of national Lassa fever surveillance data using an ecological study design.
